subject: Vendor onboarding: PO evidence & early settlement request
body_preview: Requesting PO header fields, W9, preferred net terms and whether they want early-pay enrollment (fee details).
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: accounting@cloudsentry.com
Cc: vendor-onboarding@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO evidence & early settlement request

Hi Lina,

Welcome — excited to get CloudSentry set up with Redwood. To complete vendor activation and issue a PO we need a couple of items from your side: 

- Completed vendor intake form (fillable attached) — please include legal name, remit-to address, and PO header fields you require.
- W9 or equivalent tax ID form (attachment stub is fine for now).
- Preferred net terms (Net 30/45/60) and whether you’d like to opt into our EarlyPay program (we can provide financing on Net15 for a small fee).

Quick asks: can you confirm preferred net terms and upload the W9? If you plan to enroll in EarlyPay, please note the program fee is typically 1.5% of invoice value for Net15 settlement — we can confirm exact pricing with Finance once you opt in.

Target timeline: if we receive the intake form + W9 by EOD Tue (7/6), Procurement can create the PO by 7/8 and AP will queue your first invoice for the agreed cutoff.

Attachments: Vendor_Intake_Form_Fillable.xlsx (fillable), sample PO template.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
P: (415) 555-0192

----

From: Lina Park <accounting@cloudsentry.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO evidence & early settlement request

Hi Naomi — thanks for the note. Lina here (Finance, CloudSentry).

We can provide the W9 and completed intake form — attached is our W9 as a placeholder (CloudSentry_W9.pdf). Our typical payment preference is Net45. However, we are open to the EarlyPay program for improved cash flow: would need Net15 settlement at your side in exchange for the fee you outlined. Please confirm the exact fee and whether Redwood deducts the fee up-front or invoices us separately. We prefer the fee to be a single deduction per invoice rather than a separate billing line if possible.

Also, for PO header fields: include Legal Name = CloudSentry Solutions, Remit To = 321 Harbor Ln, Suite 400, San Diego, CA 92101, Tax ID ending ***-4321. For PO acceptance, please send any required send-to email for electronic PO acknowledgement.

Attachments: CloudSentry_W9.pdf

Best,
Lina Park
Director of Finance | CloudSentry Solutions
accounting@cloudsentry.com

Forwarding Lina's response — W9 attached and they request Net45 as default. They’re also asking to enroll in EarlyPay (Net15) if fee structure is acceptable (prefer fee deducted per invoice rather than billed separately).

Internal notes / questions: 
- Can Finance accept a Net45 default? (I believe yes, but want a confirmation for the PO creation.)
- EarlyPay: do we take the 1.5% fee upfront deduction from payment, or record as a vendor-paid fee line? What’s standard for vendor communications?

Recommended next steps from my side: if Finance confirms Net45, I’ll create the vendor record and PO draft with their remit address. If EarlyPay needs Finance approval for program terms, flag to Lina that we’ll follow up with the enrollment steps.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <accounting@cloudsentry.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding: PO evidence & early settlement request

Thanks for the ping, Naomi. Quick responses below: 

- Net terms: Finance is fine with Net45 for standard vendor onboarding. Please proceed with PO creation using Net45 as the payment term.

- EarlyPay: we can offer the EarlyPay/accelerated settlement program. Standard setup is: vendor opts in, we create an EarlyPay enrollment record, and Finance will either (a) apply the agreed fee as a deduction on the settlement (preferred) or (b) process a separate vendor fee invoice if required by the vendor. Practically, we will deduct the fee from the payout for simplicity. The program fee for CloudSentry (given their volume profile) will be 1.5% for Net15.

Action items:
1) Naomi to upload CloudSentry_W9.pdf to the vendor portal and complete the intake form on their behalf if needed (I can pre-fill with the remit address provided).
2) Jordan to create PO draft with Net45 and route to Lina for PO acknowledgement (please include PO acknowledgement email: ap@cloudsentry.com).
3) David to confirm GL mapping and whether we need a contract addendum for EarlyPay.

Target dates: PO draft in our system by 7/08, confirm EarlyPay enrollment decision by 7/12 so first invoice can be settled on the agreed cutoff.

Lina — I’ll pre-fill the intake form and send you the DocuSign link for signature if that’s easiest. Let me know if CloudSentry wants the fee deducted per invoice (we’ll proceed that way) or prefers a separate billing line and we’ll update the enrollment notes.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: CloudSentry_W9.pdf, Vendor_Intake_Form_Fillable.xlsx
